column1: About being hopelessly in love with his ex-wife
Yeah I love to sing along
I used to play the bass
But now I just get high in my room
And I listen to the songs from a better time
At night my choruses all sing together
Well, we're stuck in shitty weather
I did my best to keep to the backstreets
'til I roll out of this town
Because it's so damn hard to be everything
So I set my sights to be anything
So won't you hold on to your innocence
I swear to god it's the only thing left
But if you don't want me around
And hide beneath the city's heat 'til I roll out
It's just so damn hard to be anything, to anyone, all the time
